'''Primecoin''' ([[ISO 4217#Cryptocurrencies|Abbreviation]]: '''XPM''') is a [[cryptocurrency]] that implements a [[proof-of-work system]] that searches for chains of [[prime number]]s.<ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=2wCACwAAQBAJ&dq=%22Primecoin%22&pg=PA187 | isbn=978-1-78528-615-5 | title=Learning Bitcoin | date=30 October 2015 | publisher=Packt Publishing }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gEn8EAAAQBAJ&dq=%22Primecoin%22&pg=PA80 | isbn=978-1-009-02815-8 | title=Cryptoeconomics: Economic Mechanisms Behind Blockchains | date=28 February 2024 | publisher=Cambridge University Press }}</ref>

Primecoin was launched in July 7, 2013 by Sunny King, who also founded [[Peercoin]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name="scientific" />

Unlike other cryptocurrencies, which are [[Cryptocurrency#Mining|mined]] using algorithms that solved mathematical problems with no extrinsic value, mining Primecoin involves producing chains of prime numbers ([[Cunningham chain|Cunningham]] and [[bi-twin chain]]s). These are useful to scientists and mathematicians and meet the requirements for a [[proof of work]] system of being hard to compute but easy to verify and having an adjustable difficulty.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-11-16 |title=Exploring Primecoin: An Alternative Cryptocurrency Project - Codemotion |url=https://www.codemotion.com/magazine/backend-dev/blockchain-dev/primecoin-cryptocurrency/ |access-date=2022-07-12 |website=Codemotion Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name="clark2013" /><ref name=":0">{{cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=erMQBQAAQBAJ&pg=PA175 Shortly after its launch, some trade journals reported that the rush of over 18,000 new users seeking to mine Primecoin overwhelmed providers of dedicated servers.<ref name="clark2013">{{cite news |url=https://www.theregister.co.uk/2013/07/16/digitalocean_primecoin_cloud_problems/ |title=Virtual currency speculators shut down cloud |last=Clark |first=Jack |date=16 July 2013 |work=[[The Register]] |access-date=17 November 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last=Miller |first=Rich |date=17 December 2013 |title=Currency Miners Cause Spot Shortages of Dedicated Servers |work=Data Center Knowledge |url=http://www.datacenterknowledge.com/archives/2013/12/17/currency-miners-cause-spot-shortages-dedicated-servers/ |access-date=18 December 2013}}</ref> It was ranked as being one of the top ten currencies before 2014.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/ginaclarke/2018/10/16/proof-of-stake-guru-sunny-king-blockchain-is-easy-we-just-need-to-use-it-like-a-database/|title= Proof-Of-Stake Guru Sunny King: "Blockchain Is Easy - We Just Need To Use It Like A Database"
|website=Forbes|date=October 16, 2018|author=Gina Clarke|access-date=August 2, 2024}}</ref> 

Primecoin has a [[Blockchain#Block_time|block time]] of one minute, changes difficulty every block, and has a [[block reward]] that is a function of the difficulty.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
